objective: Implement Smart Call Routing in AdminPanel and WebApi with FastAGI/Dialplan integration

inScope: Smart Call Route data model, DTOs, and file-backed store in WebApi
CallRoutesController with CRUD, active-toggle, pagination, and caller-id lookup endpoints
FastAGI / Dialplan integration support (SmartCallRouteAgiScript) and mapping in Asterisk.Console.AMI
Angular models, services, and reactive state in AdminPanel
AdminPanel Smart Call Routing UI page with table, modal add/edit, quick toggle, search, priority management, and online lookup tester
Route registration in app.routes.ts and navigation link in shell.component.html with i18n (fa/en)
outOfScope: Remote live PBX Asterisk socket modification

acceptanceCriteria: Admins can view, search, filter, and paginate smart call routing rules
Admins can add, edit, delete, and toggle active status for routing rules
Priority field is displayed in table and configurable in form
Caller number is normalized across multiple Iranian and international formats (+98, 0098, 98, 09, Persian/Arabic digits)
Lookup API returns the matched rule with TargetExtension, TargetExternalNumber, ExtensionTimeout, and OutboundTrunk
Admin UI includes a live lookup test widget allowing verification of routing rules directly
FastAGI script / Dialplan handler provides fallback handling when extension is unanswered or not configured
WebApi (.NET), FastAGI (.NET), and AdminPanel (Angular) build without errors
